hero.title: About me
hero.bioLead: I build end-to-end applications: API in Python/FastAPI, interface in React/TypeScript, data in PostgreSQL and AI integration — with real projects already in production.
hero.bio: Trained at 42 Málaga and currently studying the CFGS in Multiplatform Application Development (DAM), where I also work with Java, frontend development and other technologies. A habitual self-learner, I enjoy automating what others do by hand and I'm looking for a team to contribute to and grow with from day one.
